prerequisites: Implement a test-owned single-action native driver reusing existing card mapping, queue capture and choice helpers; do not treat bypassing full-turn solo deployment as the manual multiplayer loop.
Verify a two-player native full-party loop, branch isolation, stable recapture, session accounting and request ownership.
Admit the whole-deck recipes, capture complete party roots and prove deterministic recipe reconstruction. Generic multiplayer checkpoint restoration needs a separate contract.
Implement a test-only shared-credit ablation binding through manual requests and prove it is the sole treatment difference.
Freeze partner policies, schedules, request cadence and actor-specific choice adapters before measuring.
Record explicit outcomes for every planned arm, including unavailable advice, errors and censoring.
Pass same-policy A/A, calibrated positive controls and minimal request-coverage contracts before the multi-trajectory pilot.
Freeze full policy snapshots and permit only the declared policy-field differences in each comparison.

comparison.estimand: Effect of the existing shared-credit feature, including its gated frontier cost condition, under the registered roots and actor policies; not just the arithmetic credit formula.
comparison.exposureStrata: Register mechanism opportunities before building trajectories; report realized unattributed damage separately without conditioning the main outcome table on treatment-dependent exposure.
comparison.zeroExposureControl: Expected agreement requires zero unattributed damage on all relevant search paths and normal unsaturated arithmetic. A topic label or unchanged first action does not establish those premises.

pilot.omittedEquivalentCells: For either complete-batch order, coalesce after_peer_batch with the next first local request. Extra turns or ready withdrawal invalidate this simplification and need a separately registered sequence.

partnerPolicies.randomPlayAndIdle: Stress and negative controls only; not an empirical human population.
partnerPolicies.pilotCardPool: Use exact peer deck IDs in root-candidates.json. Native openings and tested action chains are admitted; complex extra choices remain outside the pilot. Never skip an unsupported playable draw.

pilotParameters.killEstimate: Explicit base damage 6 for Strike/Poisoned Stab, 8 for Bash; compares current enemy HP plus block, without branch simulation.

pilotParameters.unregisteredPlayableCard: Fail the trajectory; never skip it.

execution.environment: Native game actions; managed harness transport/rendering bypasses must be declared, representative loop verified in native headless.
execution.recaptureFrom: Advanced stable live CombatState on main thread, not stale live objects beside an advanced shadow state.
execution.sessionLifetime: One production combat session across all manual requests of a trajectory.
execution.actionBoundary: Complete native action, choice and triggered transaction chain before next actor.
execution.staleAdvice: Observe according to frozen request cadence; never relabel stale advice as current.
execution.invalidAdvice: Record advice_invalid, abandon remaining old route and simulate an additional manual request; never silently substitute cards or targets.
execution.missingAdviceFallback: None in pilot; stop explicitly and count unavailability.
execution.localDeath: Driver continues living actors until native terminal or a cap. Pilot observed peer death with continuing local play, but not local-first death with peer continuation or revival.
execution.reset: Rebuild run/session per trajectory, compare full/native opening, clear request hooks. Warm A/A and final MP-to-solo scope reset passed; an original repeated-process timeout remains unexplained.
execution.nativeInstanceCleanup: Use existing platform cleanup flag on the last request; retain logs outside the instance.
execution.platformProtocolChanges: Maintain Bash and PowerShell entry points together if parameters or capabilities change.
execution.cardMapping: Preserve existing state-key/occurrence matching and existing ID/occurrence fallback for legacy actions. Log the actual native instance; do not invent a separate fuzzy matcher or claim permanent identity.
execution.deploymentBoundary: Full DeployCurrentTurn also owns automatic drift/exhaustion requests and ending the turn; a test-only guard bypass alone does not implement the required interleaved manual-request loop.
execution.actorOwnership: Prove each queued native action belongs to the scheduled actor. Existing peer OnPlayWrapper fixtures do not prove peer queue identity. Any LocalContext override must be stable, isolated and restored with no search or action in flight.
execution.readyObservations: Record per-player ready before/after, withdrawal, phase and actor turn in test events; do not infer future inactivity or require a new production root/UI field.
execution.testScope: One local advisor user. Test actor scripts simulate independent teammates and local manual input; no player-facing team coordination requirement.
transportBypasses: Advisor multiplayer gate over two-player native RunState using single-process transport
AllPlayersReadyToEndTurn waits for all native participants
Native single-process enemy-start barrier; no remote acknowledgement protocol tested
renderingBypasses: Test-scoped CardPileCmd.ShuffleFtueCheck returns a completed tutorial task, leaving actual shuffle intact
Test-scoped remote NCardPlayQueue.OnActionEnqueued visual bypass; local animation and native queue execution remain
execution.environmentPreparation: Warm 153 nonempty int-backed native game enum values before run creation to avoid concurrent mutation of the native packet serializer enum cache.
execution.recordingMetrics: HP events distinguish IsInProgress=true combat changes from postcombat recovery; count both and do not treat victory healing as reduced damage taken.
execution.processReuse: Original plan used warmup plus up to 16 measured arms. After one unexplained timeout, continue only unexecuted arms with warmup plus at most 4; preserve original failure.
execution.openingRepresentation: Full-party ContinuationStamp plus normalized NetFullCombatState.ToString UTF-8 with the existing format marker; clears cross-request choice/reward counters, not a raw network-packet equality proof.

randomness.gameRng: Equal initial states; natural action-dependent consumption after branching, never forced alignment.
randomness.externalRng: Separate test-only actor and scheduler streams; never consume game RNG.
randomness.replayActionTape: Only validates its original path; not a responsive counterfactual partner.

reporting.pairedHealthSubset: Both arms complete and win; report subset size and exclusions alongside all-pair outcomes.
reporting.negativeCases: List candidate-only defeats, deaths and unavailable outcomes, plus worst health regressions by source root.
reporting.unknownOutcomes: Retain in denominator and report explicit bounds; do not relabel censoring as defeat or zero loss.
reporting.independentUnit: Original source run/deck cluster in later quality studies. The four pilot recipes are one controlled template group, with zero verified independent human sources.
reporting.withinRootWeighting: Aggregate frozen conditions within root, then weight independent roots equally; publish strata and mixture sensitivity.
reporting.formalUncertainty: Paired cluster-level interval estimates only after a predeclared adequate sample design; pilot is descriptive.
reporting.holdout: Separate source runs, deck provenance and partner families; once used for tuning, reclassify as development data.
reporting.pilotInference: Descriptive apparatus coverage only; do not estimate human between-root variance or human confidence intervals from the four controlled recipes.
reporting.counting: 64 trajectories and 32 pairs cover only B. Auxiliary control/calibration/diagnostic counts are unfrozen and must not be represented as executed or included in a fabricated all-batch total.

samePolicyAA.purpose: Check complete reset, action actor identity and RNG isolation.
samePolicyAA.timeLimitRule: If timing changes effective work, classify as an inconclusive determinism control, never an A/A pass.

candidateSources.historicalDifference: First local action changes from STRIKE_IRONCLAD to DEADLY_POISON.
The archived synthetic continuation deals 84 versus 104 damage with zero local HP loss.

positive.nativeCalibration: Historical synthetic inputs locate sensitive cases, but do not establish that complete-deck native loops reproduce them. Calibrate and freeze an explicit native witness before claiming a positive-control pass.

nativeWitness.meaning: First-action order sensitivity only; not a predeclared benefit direction.

scopeReset.checks: No experiment hooks or test policy state; ordinary solo root and one-card winning advice.

inflightPeer.scope: Worker held after root capture and before expansion; peer native action, frozen old root, stale old publication and fresh manual recapture. Not arbitrary concurrency/cancellation.

smoke_350.otherPolicySettings: Freeze and record the full current multiplayer policy snapshot; no solo growth targets.

medium_nodes_time_capped.basis: Current Medium branch/beam limits and doubled multiplayer node allowance; independent 10-second cap and DOP1. Not the complete ordinary production time allowance.

budgetCalibration.coverageDefinition: For every available request report whether the frozen comparison reaches its remaining stage deadline and whether the selected facts are comparable. Keep true native terminal, predicted terminal, local death and unavailable advice distinct; do not use maximum explored depth alone as success.
budgetCalibration.witnessGate: Both arms on preregistered nonterminal witness requests must reach comparable stage facts or an actual early native terminal. Missing this gate is insufficient coverage, not automatic fallback to Score.
budgetCalibration.diagnosticScope: Choose representative initial or earliest manual-requery roots using A coverage results; freeze the diagnostic list before comparative measurement. Do not cross this profile with all 64 pilot trajectories by default.
budgetCalibration.availableMetricsNote: Selected facts captured from the actual final selection by a test-owned observer. Maximum observed unattributed damage covers values passed through MultiplayerFactsAt, not an exhaustive inventory of every generated snapshot.

interruptionDiagnostics.sampling: Preregister stable peer-interruption points before observing treatment results.
interruptionDiagnostics.compare: Old next action versus new first action, including actual card mapping, target, potion and choice details.
interruptionDiagnostics.isolation: Run outside the episode from a frozen root and policy/session-ledger snapshot. Do not mutate original caches, previous route prefixes, ledger, request count or schedule.
interruptionDiagnostics.cost: Record diagnostic search work separately from actual manual queries and trajectory limits.
interruptionDiagnostics.interpretation: Action disagreement is sensitivity to a new root, not the value of replanning. Only paired executed continuations can estimate downstream benefit.

registrationHistory.currentIdChange: v3 records implementation status, environment bypasses and evidence. Root recipes, treatment, peer policies, schedules, cadence and budgets of B remained fixed.
